sections.en: The conjunction of Mercury and Mars

summary.headline: Mercury–Mars Conjunction Omens
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the conjunction of Mercury and Mars in Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, including effects on weather, rain, crops, fertility, disease, rulers, prisoners, women, musicians, soldiers, and regional rebellions. The conjunction in the four triplicities signifies danger to merchants, simoom winds, bureaucratic delays, official misfortune, market unrest, sedition, hostility, war, and fighting, depending on whether Mars or Mercury dominates and is elevated.
